fit_reason: Whole 1982 Pontiac Trans Am offered by a private seller; a project car but fully detailable.
findings: Black paint on the hood shows dullness and haze, with a mottled, uneven finish visible in the reflections
Dust and dirt film along the lower doors, rocker trim and rear bumper area
Dirt and road grime on the bronze lower body trim and bumper edges
Grey cloth driver seat and seatbacks look dirty and discolored, with a stained seat cover on the passenger side
Grey carpet on the passenger floor looks dusty and soiled
Dash and console look dusty and dull
Bronze snowflake wheels have dust and brake grime
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 82 Trans Am. You mentioned the paint could use a good buff, and in the photos the hood and doors look hazy, and the grey seats and carpet could clean up nicely too. We do mobile pre-sale details and machine buffing and can come to you, which works well since it needs to be trailered. Would you like a quote?
